SELECT w.workspace_id AS "workspaceId", wm.member_id AS "memberId", w.subject AS "subject", w.status AS "status"
FROM workspace_domains wd
JOIN workspaces w ON wd.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
JOIN workspace_members wm ON w.workspace_id = wm.workspace_id
WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domain} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0
